_comment: Merged over iso/agama/patina21.json by install-test.sh: the disk, user and root answers an unattended QEMU install needs, a serial console, and the first-boot answers. Throwaway credentials for a throwaway VM.

post.name: patina21-enable-firstboot
post.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /var/lib/patina21 /etc/patina21
printf 'PATINA_UNATTENDED=1\nPATINA_THEME=%s\n' "${PATINA_TEST_THEME:-template}" > /etc/patina21/firstboot.env
systemctl enable patina21-firstboot.service
